description: This file implements the configuration handling for DNS over HTTPS servers, including parsing, validation, serialization, and comparison of server configurations.

classes.name: DnsOverHttpsServerConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for a DNS over HTTPS server, including server template, endpoints, and methods for serialization and comparison.

methods.name: GetHttpsHost
methods.description: Extracts the host from an HTTPS URL, used for validation.

methods.name: IsValidDohTemplate
methods.description: Validates a DNS over HTTPS URL template and determines if it should use POST.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsServerConfig::FromString
methods.description: Creates a server config object from a template string and endpoints.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsServerConfig::ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the server config to a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsServerConfig::FromValue
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON dictionary into a server config object.
